title: Boolean Identities / De Morgan — 逻辑定律速查
markdown:
#### Boolean Identities / De Morgan — 逻辑定律速查


<!-- SVG_SOURCE:boolean-algebra-laws/v02-compact.svg -->
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 894 560" width="894" height="560">
<rect width="894" height="560" fill="#f5f8fc"/>
<rect x="17" y="16" width="860" height="44" rx="7" fill="#21619d"/>
<text x="33" y="45" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#ffffff">定律</text>
<text x="275" y="45" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#ffffff">公式</text>
<text x="695" y="45" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#ffffff">用途</text>
<rect x="17" y="60" width="860" height="62" fill="#ffffff"/>
<text x="33" y="98" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">Identity 恒等律</text>
<text x="275" y="84" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A & 1 = A</text>
<text x="275" y="107" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A | 0 = A</text>
<text x="695" y="98" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">消掉 1 或 0</text>
<line x1="17" y1="122" x2="877" y2="122" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect x="17" y="122" width="860" height="62" fill="#edf3f8"/>
<text x="33" y="160" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">Null 零一律</text>
<text x="275" y="146" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A & 0 = 0</text>
<text x="275" y="169" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A | 1 = 1</text>
<text x="695" y="160" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">直接确定结果</text>
<line x1="17" y1="184" x2="877" y2="184" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect x="17" y="184" width="860" height="62" fill="#ffffff"/>
<text x="33" y="222" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">Idempotent 幂等律</text>
<text x="275" y="208" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A & A = A</text>
<text x="275" y="231" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A | A = A</text>
<text x="695" y="222" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">相同变量合并</text>
<line x1="17" y1="246" x2="877" y2="246" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect x="17" y="246" width="860" height="62" fill="#edf3f8"/>
<text x="33" y="284" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">Complement 互补律</text>
<text x="275" y="270" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A & !A = 0</text>
<text x="275" y="293" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A | !A = 1</text>
<text x="695" y="284" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">正反变量抵消</text>
<line x1="17" y1="308" x2="877" y2="308" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect x="17" y="308" width="860" height="56" fill="#ffffff"/>
<text x="33" y="343" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">Combining 合并律</text>
<text x="275" y="343" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">(A & B) | (A & !B) = A</text>
<text x="695" y="343" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">合并两种情况</text>
<line x1="17" y1="364" x2="877" y2="364" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect x="17" y="364" width="860" height="62" fill="#edf3f8"/>
<text x="33" y="402" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">Absorption 吸收律</text>
<text x="275" y="388" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A | (A & B) = A</text>
<text x="275" y="411" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A & (A | B) = A</text>
<text x="695" y="402" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">去掉多余部分</text>
<line x1="17" y1="426" x2="877" y2="426" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect x="17" y="426" width="860" height="56" fill="#ffffff"/>
<text x="33" y="461" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">Distributive 分配律</text>
<text x="275" y="461" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">A & (B | C) = (A & B) | (A & C)</text>
<text x="695" y="461" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">展开或提取公因式</text>
<line x1="17" y1="482" x2="877" y2="482" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect x="17" y="482" width="860" height="62" fill="#edf3f8"/>
<text x="33" y="520" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#17334b">De Morgan 德摩根定律</text>
<text x="275" y="506" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">!(A & B) = !A | !B</text>
<text x="275" y="529" font-family="DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#21619d">!(A | B) = !A & !B</text>
<text x="695" y="520" font-family="Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" fill="#17334b">把 NOT 移进括号</text>
<line x1="17" y1="544" x2="877" y2="544" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<line x1="259" y1="60" x2="259" y2="544" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
<line x1="679" y1="60" x2="679" y2="544" stroke="#dbe5ef" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
```
